key_catalyst: The 10-year Treasury yield fell 6 basis points to 4.36%, supporting a broad semiconductor-led QQQ rally.
reasoning: Today's yield-driven, semiconductor-led advance indicates the recent chip-valuation shock is being absorbed rather than escalating, while early earnings results are tracking ahead of expectations. The new tariff measures are a moderate unresolved overhang, but their intraday market impact was outweighed by broad risk-on participation and there is no high-severity catalyst signaling a material next-open gap-down risk.
